source_contract.historical_namespace_pins: R2/NAMESPACE_PIN.json is offline provenance only; R3 neither reads it nor imports historical namespace constants

configuration_trust_boundary.who_configures_reader: trusted B host implementation, never model/question JSON or a caller-provided verified/complete flag
configuration_trust_boundary.reader_output: captured actual complete global AZONE/MIDDLEWARE requests, schemas and all response pages from one verified source snapshot/read-isolation generation
configuration_trust_boundary.no_authentication_claim: The module cannot authenticate an arbitrary Python callback. Its configured callback is trusted host code; plain flags or dictionaries cannot configure it. B must not wrap untrusted caller JSON in a trusted callback.
configuration_trust_boundary.source_consistency: snapshot_id is B capture metadata grounded in an actual source version/read lock or equivalent proven isolation; it is not a new CI/API field and must not be an invented UUID passed off as consistency proof
configuration_trust_boundary.unavailable_proof_policy: without such trusted B source/completeness/consistency state, integration remains blocked; no fallback to old record equality

current_capture_validation.request: exact GET instances CI AZONE and MIDDLEWARE, global constraints=[]; each page request keeps the same CI/method/scope and correct pageNo/pageSize
current_capture_validation.response: HTTP200, success not false, no error, objList list, valid integer page metadata, contiguous requested/returned pages, stable totals/page size, exact page lengths, all pages/records present, stable verified source snapshot
current_capture_validation.true_empty: totalNum=0, empty objList, known schema and a successful first-page receipt; totalPageNo may be 0 or 1
current_capture_validation.global_relation: on this complete current global directory: each name -> one logical ID; each logical ID -> one name; all middleware logical IDs resolve; required region fields nonempty
current_capture_validation.requested_region: one explicit supported name in this current directory; new valid names/IDs/AZs/middleware and consistent ID replacements are allowed
current_capture_validation.new_data_eligibility: same general schema/completeness/relation rules, never equality to historical resource contents
